description: Source code for a network logging backend in Zephyr RTOS, handling socket communication for log transmission over UDP, including initialization, address configuration, and processing log messages.

methods.name: line_out
methods.description: Sends log data over UDP socket, used as output callback.

methods.name: do_net_init
methods.description: Initializes network socket, binds, and connects to syslog server.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes log messages, initializes network if needed, and outputs logs.

methods.name: log_backend_net_set_addr
methods.description: Sets the address of the syslog server.

methods.name: log_backend_net_hostname_set
methods.description: Sets hostname for network backend (if enabled).

methods.name: init_net
methods.description: Initializes network backend, sets server address, or deactivates.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Enables panic mode for the backend.

methods.name: log_backend_net_get
methods.description: Returns pointer to the network log backend structure.
